description: This Java source file defines the 'JobExecutionRepository' class, which interacts with a database to manage and query job execution details within the context of a batch processing system, likely using Spring Batch. It includes methods to identify stuck jobs, count them, retrieve job-related dates, and update job statuses, with support for different database types like PostgreSQL and MySQL.

classes.name: JobExecutionRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing database access methods for job execution management, including finding stuck jobs, counting, retrieving job dates, and updating statuses within a batch processing framework.

methods.name: getStuckJobNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job names that are considered stuck based on their execution status and retry threshold.

methods.name: getStuckJobCountByJobName
methods.description: Returns the count of stuck job instances for the specified job name.

methods.name: getStuckJobIdsByJobName
methods.description: Retrieves the IDs of job executions that are considered stuck for the specified job name.

methods.name: getNotCompletedPartitionsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of partitions (steps) within a job execution that are not marked as completed.

methods.name: updateJobStatusToFailed
methods.description: Updates the status of a stuck job and its steps to 'FAILED'.

methods.name: getBusinessDateOfRunningJobByExecutionParameter
methods.description: Fetches the business date of a running job instance based on specific parameters and supports different database types.
